title: It is not nonstick
text: It is not nonstick. This pan is not nonstick. Food will stick to it. The pan is heavy, and it looks nice, but it proved to be nonstick immediately.

product_metadata.title: Red Volcano Textured Ceramic Nonstick, 12" Frying Pan Skillet with Stainless Steel Handles, PFAS PFOA & PTFE Free, Dishwasher Safe, Oven & Broiler Safe to 600 Degrees, Red
features: Go with the Flow: Unique Lavaflow technology fuses ceramic nonstick with plutonic rock. Plutonic rock is a dynamic substance formed by unbelievable heat and pressure that can stand temperatures up to 1400°F.
Cook in the Red Zone: Red Volcano’s textured nonstick spreads oil evenly for better frying, plus it’s 10x longer lasting and heats 5x faster than traditional coatings
Toxin-Free: Free of PFAS, PFOA, lead, and cadmium
Made from heavy-gauge aluminum for quick and even heating
Stainless steel handle stays cool thanks to a v-shaped cutout
Dishwasher safe for quick and easy cleanup
description: This frypan features Red Volcano’s textured coating, which spreads oil evenly for better frying. It’s 10x longer lasting and heats 5x faster than traditional coatings because it combines the ease of ceramic nonstick with the strength of plutonic rock!
